scripts.dev: npm run build --workspace @sigra/domain && concurrently -n WEB,API -c green,cyan "npm run dev --workspace @sigra/web" "npm run dev --workspace @sigra/api"
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @sigra/domain && npm run build --workspace @sigra/web && npm run build --workspace @sigra/api
scripts.test: npm run build --workspace @sigra/domain && node --test packages/domain/tests/*.test.mjs && npm run test --workspace @sigra/api && node --import tsx --test apps/web/tests/*.test.ts
